news.detail: Tucker played three offensive snaps and handled a carry on all of them, punching in a short two-yard touchdown in the second quarter. Tucker would likely be the biggest beneficiary in the event of a Bucky Irving injury, leaving Kenny Gainwell in a change-of-pace receiving role.
